title: When are bosonic Gaussian states classical to learn?
abstract: arXiv:2609.26705v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A fundamental question in physics is: When does classical behavior emerge from quantum systems? Bosonic Gaussian states provide a natural setting to explore this quantum-classical boundary, as they capture both the classical field behavior and the intrinsic quantum nature of light. Here, we address this problem from a learning-theoretic perspective by asking: When are bosonic Gaussian states classical to learn? That is, under what conditions (if any) can an n-mode bosonic Gaussian state be learned with as few samples, and with operations as simple, as are needed to learn a classical 2n-variate Gaussian distribution? translated_title: 玻色高斯态何时是经典可学习的？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.26705v1 公告类型：交叉（cross）摘要：物理学中的一个根本问题是：经典行为何时从量子系统中涌现？玻色高斯态为探索这一量子-经典边界提供了一个天然的研究框架，因为它们既刻画了经典场的行为，又刻画了光的内在量子特性。本文从学习理论的视角来探讨这一问题，提出：玻色高斯态何时是经典可学习的？换言之，在什么条件下（如果存在的话），一个n模玻色高斯态可以用与学习经典2n元高斯分布所需的同样少的样本和同样简单的操作来学习？我们建立了一个由态的热涨落所支配的学习能力的平滑过渡：- 冷高斯态在学习上是非经典的：当协方差矩阵满足 $\Sigma\le(\frac12+O(\frac1n))I$（即接近真空协方差）时，在单拷贝（即非纠缠）测量下的层析（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文从学习理论角度刻画了玻色高斯态的经典可学习性，证明学习能力随态的热涨落呈现平滑过渡，其中接近真空协方差的冷高斯态在单拷贝测量下是非经典可学习的。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes when bosonic Gaussian states are classical to learn from a learning-theoretic perspective, establishing a smooth crossover in learnability governed by thermal fluctuations, where cold Gaussian states near vacuum covariance are non-classical to learn under single-copy measurements.
